title: sources/<source>.toml
description: One source, named after the file stem (MG-REQ-0306), with the keys of MG-REQ-0376 for its kind.

database.description: A database source, read through ADBC: connection is required (MG-REQ-0376.3).

raw.description: Whether the source is kept in the raw zone.

retention.description: How long raw data is kept.

location.description: A local directory or an object-store URL prefix.

load.description: The load put on the source.

max_connections.description: The most connections opened at once.

window.description: When the source may be read.

query_timeout.description: The longest a query may run.

overlap.description: How far before the last mark a read starts.

files.description: A files source, Parquet, CSV or JSON: location is required (MG-REQ-0376.4).

raw.description: Whether the source is kept in the raw zone.

retention.description: How long raw data is kept.

location.description: A local directory or an object-store URL prefix.

load.description: The load put on the source.

max_connections.description: The most connections opened at once.

window.description: When the source may be read.

query_timeout.description: The longest a query may run.

overlap.description: How far before the last mark a read starts.

tables.description: The declared tables, each with a path and a format.

rest.description: A REST source: any other key is accepted until extract/rest.md is due (MG-REQ-0376.7).

tables.description: One table per declared table, keyed by its name (MG-REQ-0376.6).

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.description: The options of the table of this name.

file_tables.description: One table per declared table of a files source, keyed by its name (MG-REQ-0376.6).

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.description: The options of the table of this name.

table.description: The load options of a table (MG-REQ-0376.6).

incremental.description: The column that marks new and changed rows.

overlap.description: How far before the last mark a read starts.

delete_check.description: How often deleted rows are looked for.

delete_window.description: How far back deleted rows are looked for.

file_table.description: The load options of a table of a files source, with its path and format (MG-REQ-0376.6).

incremental.description: The column that marks new and changed rows.

overlap.description: How far before the last mark a read starts.

delete_check.description: How often deleted rows are looked for.

delete_window.description: How far back deleted rows are looked for.

path.description: A glob under the location of the source.

key.description: A name, or a non-empty list of names.

oneOf.description: The empty list, which also matches the list above, so oneOf rejects it.

secret.description: A secret reference secret:<name>, the name of MG-REQ-0305 (MG-REQ-1001).

duration.description: A positive integer followed by m, h or d, such as 6h (MG-REQ-0366.5).
